dialogues.speaker: Suspicious Notice
dialogues.text: "Within this little plot, both danger and luck are found.\nTo tell the fake from real, look where the <color=#00E1FFFF>strange rock</color> lights the ground."

dialogues.speaker: Suspicious Notice
dialogues.text: (A line of tiny text is written in the corner of the notice, easy to miss if one isn't paying attention.)\n"That main gate is locked down hard, so don't bother trying until the skies fall apart."
